title: Red Hat Security Advisory: A Subscription Management tool for finding and reporting Red Hat product usage
description: Red Hat Discovery is a tool that inspects and reports environment data about Red Hat product usage across networks. The advisory describes it as a subscription management tool but does not specify any particular vulnerability or exploit affecting it. The vendor advisory explicitly states that no fixes are currently available for the listed CVEs, including CVE-2026-8932, and does not provide mitigation steps. The advisory also references multiple CVEs affecting related components but does not confirm active exploitation or patch availability. The overall impact and technical details for CVE-2026-8932 are not detailed beyond the general description of the tool.
